## Checklist

      file / single binary with no install or build step — and I verified this.

- [ ] Format matches exactly: `- [tool](link) — Description ending with a period.`

- [ ] The link is a working, plain **canonical** repository URL (no affiliate/tracking).
- [ ] Not a duplicate of an existing entry.
- [ ] `node scripts/lint.mjs` passes locally.
